Every **Sunday 10:00 AM ET** the full week goes under the light here: every pick graded, room-by-room records, units trend, challenge progress, what the model nailed and what it missed, and a look at the week ahead.

**MID-WEEK SNAPSHOT (through 7/22):**

🗓️ **Next full report: SUNDAY JULY 27, 10:00 AM ET** — first edition, right here. 🤖

🐋 **MONTHLY DEEP-DIVE — Whale Room intelligence.**
The **1st of every month, 6:00 PM ET**, the entire month goes under the microscope: every pick re-graded, closing line value on every play, room-by-room ROI, model diagnostics — where the edge came from, where it leaked, and the attack plan for the month ahead. This is the report that makes the Whale Room the Whale Room.

🗓️ **Next drop: FRIDAY AUGUST 1, 6:00 PM ET** — the July edition, first of the series. 🤖

🐋 **MONTHLY DEEP-DIVE — the Whale Room's signature report.**
The **1st of every month, 6:00 PM ET**, the whole month goes under the knife. Lower rooms get the scoreboard — you get the autopsy:

📊 **The Ledger** — every pick re-graded, ROI per room
📈 **The CLV Ledger** — our price vs the closing price on every play. Beat-the-close % and average CLV. The number pros judge a service by. *(Whale-only — never leaves this room.)*
🧠 **Model Internals** — calibration by price band, which parameter families earned their keep, biggest miss + the exact fix applied
🎯 **The Edge Map** — ROI by market, sport, and price band: where next month's volume goes
🩸 **Drawdown Autopsy** — worst streak, root cause, and the rule now in place
🏦 **Bankroll Lab** — unit-sizing guidance for a whale bankroll, challenge ledger, projected path
🔭 **Next Month's Attack Plan** — new edges the model is testing. You see them weeks before anyone else.

🗓️ **Next drop: FRIDAY AUGUST 1, 6:00 PM ET** — the July edition. 🤖

commands.text:
🛠️ **WELCOME TO THE ISSUES CHANNEL** 🛠️

Something off? This is the place. Post here about:
• 🖼️ Wrong picture / matchup / weather on a pick card
• 💳 Payment or billing problems
• 🔑 Role or room-access problems (paid but can't see your tier)
• 📊 Wrong odds, lines, scores, or missing picks
• Anything else that looks broken

**How it works:**
1️⃣ Describe your issue — I open a ticket instantly
2️⃣ If it's something I can fix myself, I fix it on the spot and ask you to **confirm the fix (yes/no)**
3️⃣ If it needs the admin, I'll tell you it's been **escalated** and we'll get back to you as soon as an admin is available

I'm watching this channel 24/7. One issue per message keeps things fast. 🚀
— 🤖 SHiFT
